description: Implementation of NetworkStatusObserver class handling network connectivity status and security token retrieval for the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: NetworkStatusObserver
classes.description: Singleton class managing network connectivity status and security token retrieval.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkStatusObserver.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, either from environment/config or via security agent.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the device is connected to the internet, subscribing to status change events if needed.

methods.name: onConnectionStatusChangedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles internet connection status change events.
